content.title: Why Medifast (MED) Stock Is Up Today
content.summary: Shares of wellness company Medifast (NYSE:MED) jumped 3.6% in the afternoon session after reports highlighted a consensus analyst price target suggesting a potential upside of more than 51%. A survey of recent analyst ratings showed a consensus target price for Medifast at $16.50. This price level implied a potential gain of 51.31% for the stock from its trading price at the time of the report. The bullish outlook appeared to have resonated with investors.
